fields.description: A name for you, e.g. 'Carbonite' or 'Personal'. Used to pick the account when installing.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The organisation or username exactly as it appears in a repository URL — Carbonite-Solutions-Ltd, buildwithmoi. Not an email address.
fields.label: GitHub Account

fields.description: Organisations and users are different endpoints on GitHub's API, so this has to be right or the repository list comes back empty.
fields.label: Account Type

fields.description: Pre-selected when you open the install dialog.
fields.label: Default

fields.description: A GitHub personal access token with the 'repo' scope. Required to LIST private repositories — an SSH key cannot query GitHub's API, only clone over ssh. Leave blank if you only need public repositories. Cloning still uses your SSH key; this token is only ever used to read the repository and branch lists.
fields.label: Access Token

fields.description: Optional. If ~/.ssh/config defines a Host block for this account (e.g. github-carbonite), put it here and clones will use it, which pins the right key. Leave blank to use github.com.
fields.label: SSH Host Alias

fields.description: Cached from GitHub so the install dialog can search instantly. Re-sync after creating a new repository.
fields.label: Repositories
